root_layer.description: Shell-based installer framework for STARCORE 6.x-8.x layers

platform_layer.description: Production Python application — FastAPI + AI orchestration

issues.title: STARCORE 8.x has no installer or release
issues.description: The last git commit is 'STARCORE 8 migration checkpoint' but only a preflight_STARCORE_8_MIGRATION_AUDIT.sh and runtime/migration/starcore_8_preflight.json exist. No install_STARCORE_8_MASTER.sh, no runtime/8x/ directory, no STARCORE_8_RELEASE.json.
issues.fix: Implement install_STARCORE_8_MASTER.sh and run it to create all STARCORE 8.x layers and release artifacts.

issues.title: current_release.json shows 7.10.x, not 8.x
issues.description: runtime/releases/current_release.json reports version 7.10.01/current:7.10.10 but STARCORE 8.x is claimed as PRODUCTION.
issues.fix: Update current_release.json after STARCORE 8.x installation completes.

issues.title: Overlapping installer scripts for 6BX31-35 range
issues.description: Three scripts cover overlapping ranges: install_6BX31_35_master.sh (374 lines), install_6BX31_40_master_part1.sh (442 lines), install_6BX35_40_master_part2.sh (509 lines). BX31-35 is duplicated.
issues.fix: Keep install_6BX31_40_master_part1.sh + install_6BX35_40_master_part2.sh as the authoritative pair; mark install_6BX31_35_master.sh as superseded.

issues.title: runtime/audit/ directory did not exist
issues.description: The audit output path runtime/audit/ was not present before this session.

issues.title: 313 JSON files in runtime/ — potential bloat
issues.description: The runtime/ directory contains 313 JSON state files. Many are snapshots and historical records. No consolidation strategy exists.
issues.fix: Implement runtime/audit/registry_index.json as a master index. Archive snapshots older than 30 days.

issues.title: requirements.txt only lists build tools
issues.description: requirements.txt contains only packaging, setuptools, wheel. The real Python environment is managed by platform/pyproject.toml via uv.
issues.fix: Add a comment clarifying root requirements.txt is for build only; platform/ manages its own deps via uv.

issues.title: Two distinct architectures coexist
issues.description: The project has two layers: (1) root-level shell-installer + JSON-registry layer (STARCORE 6-8) and (2) platform/ production Python FastAPI application (v0.4.0, 792 tests, 100% coverage). These serve different purposes and should be clearly separated in documentation.
issues.fix: Maintain clear separation. The platform/ Python app is the real runtime; the root-level layer is the deployment/registry framework.
